newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine weekly official crop progress.
newsitem.headline: Argentine weekly official crop progress.

text.p: Argentine farmers had harvested 45.2 percent of their 1996/97 soybean crop by April 25, the Agriculture Secretariat said in weekly crop report Wednesday.

The Secretariat repeated comments it has made in earlier crop reports about the bad state of much of the crop, which was hit by drought. Maize harvesting was 60.4 percent complete. In many northern and inland crop zones, the maize has also been hit by dryness. In other areas, including Buenos Aires and southern Santa Fe, the maize was hit by Rio Cuarto virus. Sorghum harvesting was 55.1 percent complete.
